spans.s:
Sin,Ⓒs.ⒹpApaM, pAtakaM, enas n., kalmazaM, duritaM, aGaM, duzkftaM, vfjinaM, aMhas n., kilbizaM, paMkaH-kaM, pApman m., kaluzaM; dozaH, aparADaH, pApa-apa-karma n., kukarman, duzkfti f. -tyaM; ‘heinous s(in)’ mahA-Gora-pAtakaM; ‘destroying s(in)’ pApanASana-nASin, aGamarzaRa, pApApaha.
Ⓔv. i.ⒹpApaM &c. Acar 1 P or kf, aparAD 4, 5 P, duz 4 P.
Ⓝ[Sin]ner,Ⓒs.ⒹSee Sinful below; ‘an atrocious s(inner)’ mahA-Gora-pAtakin-pApin, pAparASiH-niDiH.
Ⓝ[Sin]ful,Ⓒa.ⒹpApin, pAtakin, pApakara (rI f.), pApman, pApakft, pApAtman, kukarman, duzkarman, enasvin, pApa-duzwa-karman, aparADin, kilbizin, pApa-nirata-budDi-mati, pApAtmaka.
Ⓑ
 2 (Of acts) pApa in comp., duzwa; kaluza; ‘s(inful) act’ pApaM, duzkarma; See (s.).
Ⓝ[Sin]fully,Ⓒadv.ⒹpApavat, sapApaM, duzwavat.
Ⓝ[Sin]fulness,Ⓒs.ⒹsapApatA, pApamati-nirati f., duzwatA, &c.
Ⓝ[Sin]less,Ⓒa.ⒹanaGa, nizpApa, apApa, akalmaza, pAparahita, nirdoza, niraparADa, and sim. comp.
Since,Ⓒprep.ⒹpraBfti, AraBya, (with abl.), A with abl. or in comp.; sometimes also ex. by gen. abs.; asya katipaye saM-vatsarAstapastapyamAnasya (

) ‘it is several years s(ince) he began to practise penance’; ‘s(ince) then’ tadApraBfti; ‘4 years s(ince)’ itaH pUrvaM caturvarzaM; ‘long s(ince)’ ciraM; ‘ever s(ince)’ yataH praBfti.
Ⓑ
 2 pUrvaM, prAk, gata-pUrva-kAle.
Ⓔconj.ⒹyataH, yasmAt, yat, hi (not at beginning); by abl. of abstract noun; See Because.

Sincere,Ⓒa.Ⓓakftrima, nirvyAja, nizkapawa, nirvyalIka, dakziRa, fju, sarala, viSudDa, amAya; yaTArTa, satya, tAttvika-vAstavika- (kI f.); (of persons only) SudDamati-BAva, SudDAtman, vimalAtman, Suci, satyaSIla-vrata-vAdin; See Frank, Honest.
Ⓝ[Sincere]ly,Ⓒadv.ⒹnirvyAjaM, nirvyalIkaM, amAyayA, SudDahfdayena-BAvena, vimalAtmanA.
Ⓝ[Sincer]ity, [Sincere]ness,Ⓒs.ⒹsAralyaM, dAkziRyaM, ArjavaM, nizkApawyaM, amAyA, vimalAtmatA, SOcaM, yaTArTatA, &c.

Sinew,Ⓒs.ⒹsnAyu f., snasA; (‘s(inew)s’) balaM, Sakti f., sAmarTyaM.
Ⓝ[Sinew]y,Ⓒa.ⒹsnAyumaya (yI f.).
Ⓑ
 2 pra-sa-bala.

Sing,Ⓒv. i.ⒹgE 1 P; (of birds) kUj 1 P, ru 2 P.
Ⓔv. t.ⒹgE; gAnena varR or kFt 10, utkFt, aBigE; ‘they sang his praises’ taM stutiBirupatasTire.
Ⓝ[Sing]er, Songster,Ⓒs.ⒹgAyakaH, gAtf m.
Ⓝ[Sing]ing, Song,Ⓒs.ⒹgItaM, gIti f., geyaM, gAnaM.
Ⓑ
 2 kUjanaM, rutaM, rAvaH, ravaH.
Singe,Ⓒv. t.ⒹIzad dah 1 P, agninA spfS 6 P.

Single,Ⓒa.Ⓓeka, ekAkin, advitIya, kevala, asahAya; advEDa (DI f.).
Ⓑ
 2 Binna, vyakta, avi-Bakta.
Ⓑ
 3 Simple, q. v.
Ⓑ
 4 anUQa, avivAhita, akftodvAha, niHsaMga; ‘s(ingle) combat’ dvaMdvayudDaM, niyudDaM, bAhuyudDaM; ‘s(ingle)-handed’ eka, ekAkin, bAhusahAya, BujamAtrasahAya; ‘s(ingle)-hearted’ ananyavftti, ekacitta; ‘s(ingle) stick’ yazwi f., daMqaH.
Ⓔv. t.Ⓓ(Out) (bahUnAM maDyAt) vf 5 U, udDf 1 P, ud-grah 9 P; nirUp 10, nirdiS 6 P.
Ⓝ[Single]ness,Ⓒs.ⒹkEvalyaM, advitIyatA, &c.
Ⓑ
 2 SudDi f., ananyatA, ananyaBAvaH.
ⓃSingly,Ⓒadv.ⒹEx. by (a.).
Ⓑ
 2 ekEkaM, ekEkaSaH, pratyekaM, ekaSaH, pfTak, pfTak pfTak; See Separately.

Singular,Ⓒa.ⒹapUrva, apratima, advitIya, apratirUpa, anupama.
Ⓑ
 2 ananyasADAraRa (RI f.), lokottara, ananyasAmAnya; aparUpa, vilakzaRa, adButa, lokabAhya, alOkika (kI f.); ‘s(ingular) number’ ekavacanaM.
Ⓝ[Singular]ity,Ⓒs.ⒹapUrvatA, apratimatA, asAmAnyatA, vElakzaRyaM, vEcitryaM, asaMgati f., lokottaratA.
Ⓝ[Singular]ly,Ⓒadv.ⒹapUrvaM, viSezataH, adButaM, lokottaraprakAreRa.

Sinister,Ⓒa.ⒹamaMgala, aSuBa, akalyARa (RI f.), aBadra.
Ⓑ
 2 duzwa, vakra, vAma, kuwila, anfju.
Ⓑ
 3 vAma, savya; ‘of s(inister) motives’ du-rASaya, pApamati; umAM sa paSyannfjunEva cakzuzA (K. v. 32) ‘looking at Uma with no s(inister) eye’.
ⓃSinistrally,Ⓒadv.ⒹvAmataH, vAmadiSi.
ⓃSinistrous,Ⓒa.ⒹvAmasTa, vAma-pArSvavartin.

Sink,Ⓒv. i.Ⓓni-masj 6 P; ‘sank in deep mire’ mahApaMke nimagnaH; sad 1 P, ava-ni-°, aDaH gam 1 P or pat 1 P or yA 2 P, ava-pat.
Ⓑ
 2 hrAsaM-kzayaM yA-i 2 P, kzi pass., DvaMs 1 A; See Decay, Decline.
Ⓑ
 3 (Down) ava-vi-sad, pari-, mlE-glE 1 P, sraMs 1 A; See Droop; ‘my heart s(ink)s down’ sIdati me hfdayaM; ‘limbs, s(ink)ing down through excessive thirst’ prabala-pipAsAvasannAni aMgakAni (

); ‘his heart sank within him’ tasya DEryamahI-yata; sa lupta-sKalita-DEryaH. []
Ⓔv. t.Ⓓni-masj c. (majjayati); aDaH gam c. or pat c.
Ⓑ
 2 (A well &c.) Kan 1 P.
Ⓑ
 3 avasad c., pari-, mlE c. (spirits &c.).
Ⓑ
 4 nyUnIkf 8 U, alpIkf, laGayati (D.), hras c., apaci 5 U; kzi 5 P.
Ⓔs.ⒹjalanirgamaH, guptanAlI.

Sinuous,Ⓒa.Ⓓkuwila, vakra, arAla, jihma.
ⓃSinuosity,Ⓒs.Ⓓvakriman m., kOwilyaM.
